newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan's CMC Magnetics up on U.S. orders.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan's CMC Magnetics up on U.S. orders.

text.p: Taiwan's CMC Magnetics Corp rose in active trading on Thursday on news that it has won videotape orders worth about US$20 million from the United States for 1997, brokers said.
After 85 minutes, CMC, one of Taiwan's leading videotape and computer disk makers, jumped T$1.2 or 2.74 percent to T$45.
"The large order gives a good incentive to buy the stock. Besides, CMC's share price is still relatively low," said Albert Lin of Golden Securities.
CMC predicted big leaps in profit and sales for 1997.
The firm forecast 1997 profit at T$1 billion on turnover of T$4.4 billion, compared with a 1996 profit projection of T$450 million on turnover of T$2.7-3.0 billion, a spokeswoman said.
